name: 多元储物大容量收纳书柜款
description: 开放格架加封闭底柜分层收纳，雾蓝家居场景套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating misty blue-grey lifestyle walls #C9D4D9 and warm-white infographic sections #FFFFFF with light warm grey rounded cards #F0EFED
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft natural window light around 5000K for scenes, even high-key studio light for infographics, soft contact shadows only, single consistent light direction per shot
styleLock.surfaceSystem: pale wood floor and natural wood-grain cabinet surfaces, matte finish
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, heavy near-black #2D2D2D headline typography with corner-quote 「」 motif and small two-tone circular section markers
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line 1.5px near-black #2D2D2D icons with short sky-blue #2FA8E1 underline accents
styleLock.presentationRules: product always centered, stable front 3/4 hero angle reused across shots, true natural wood-grain finish, full silhouette visible, contact shadow grounding
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean home-furniture ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty blue-grey wall #C9D4D9, warm white #FFFFFF, light warm grey #F0EFED, one sky-blue accent #2FA8E1 and one soft amber secondary accent #F0A32F; neutral overall temperature with warm natural wood product tones; modern geometric sans-serif headline typography with corner-quote 「」 motif and small two-tone circular section markers; alternating misty-blue lifestyle walls and warm-white infographic sections with light warm grey rounded cards; bright soft natural window light around 5000K for scenes and even high-key studio light for infographics, soft contact shadows only; thin-line 1.5px near-black icons with sky-blue underline accents; product always centered, stable front 3/4 hero angle, true natural wood-grain finish, full silhouette visible; balanced full compositions where furniture and copy share the frame; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏一秒传递多元收纳的核心利益，赢下详情页停留
shots.camera: slightly low camera height looking gently upward, front 3/4 angle, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright soft natural window light from front-left, 5000K, soft contact shadow under the base
shots.background: misty blue-grey painted wall #C9D4D9 with pale wood floor
shots.props: a few stacked books, one white ceramic vase, one small potted plant, one fabric storage box placed inside compartments; never covering the silhouette
shots.textZone: top-center copy block set on the calm wall area: a small sky-blue #2FA8E1 capsule label 「{selling_point_1}」 above a two-line #2D2D2D headline 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: Detail-page opening hero for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: communicate diversified storage at one glance. Camera at slightly low height looking gently upward, front 3/4 angle, full product standing on a pale wood floor against the misty blue-grey wall #C9D4D9, styled with a few books, one white ceramic vase, one small potted plant and one fabric storage box inside the compartments, props never covering the silhouette. Bright soft natural window light from front-left at 5000K, soft contact shadow grounding the base. Product occupies 60-70% of frame as the commanding centerpiece, its tall silhouette running through the full composition. Text zone: a top-center copy block sits on the calm upper wall area, a small sky-blue #2FA8E1 capsule label reading 「{selling_point_1}」 above a short two-line headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D. 2K, clean commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logos, no watermark, no QR code, no dense body text, no cluttered props, no floating product, no people, no warped shelf lines, no duplicated background objects.

shots.intent: 放大杂物无章的痛点，让买家对号入座产生需求
shots.camera: matched eye-level straight-on view on both panels, identical framing and crop
shots.lighting: left panel slightly dim directional light, right panel brighter even light, shadow direction consistent on both sides
shots.background: warm white #FFFFFF page with a thin light warm grey #F0EFED divider between panels
shots.props: left panel: piled books, toys and sundries on the floor; right panel: the same items sorted inside {product}
shots.textZone: one short pain label 「{callout_1}」 over the left panel, one short solution label 「{callout_2}」 over the right panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: agitate clutter chaos, then show the relief. Two matched panels with identical eye-level camera, framing and shadow logic: left panel a lived-in room corner with books, toys and sundries heaped messily on the floor under slightly dim directional light; right panel the same corner tidied with {product} standing neatly as the anchor of the scene, occupying 50-60% of the panel with items sorted into open compartments and the closed cabinet under brighter even light. Warm white #FFFFFF page with a thin light warm grey #F0EFED divider; both panels run edge to edge so the before-and-after contrast fills the full canvas. Text zones: short pain label 「{callout_1}」 over the left panel and short solution label 「{callout_2}」 over the right panel, both in #2D2D2D. 2K. Negative: no fabricated statistics, no distorted room geometry, no extra text, no watermark, no visible faces, no duplicated background objects, no contradictory shadows.

shots.intent: 正视结构标注讲清台面、开放格、底柜三段分区，破除装不装的疑虑
shots.lighting: even flat high-key studio light, minimal shadow
shots.background: clean white #FFFFFF with a light warm grey #F0EFED floor line
shots.textZone: section headline 「{selling_point_1}」 centered above with a small two-tone circular index mark; three numbered circular markers on product zones with thin leader lines to short labels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic structure callout screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: explain large-capacity zoning at a glance. Straight-on 90-degree front elevation of {product}, centered on a clean white #FFFFFF background with a light warm grey #F0EFED floor line, the full cabinet filling 65-75% of the frame so every zone stays readable. Even flat high-key studio light, minimal shadow, crisp vertical lines. Section headline 「{selling_point_1}」 centered above with a small two-tone circular index mark. Three numbered sky-blue #2FA8E1 circular markers 1 2 3 placed on the top display surface, the open compartments and the bottom closed cabinet, each with a thin leader line to a short label 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D. 2K. Negative: no warped vertical lines, no perspective distortion, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logos, no extra decorations.

shots.intent: 三区圆形放大证明收纳分区真实可用
shots.camera: three circular crops: 45-degree high-angle top surface, 90-degree top-down into compartments, straight-on cabinet doors
shots.lighting: soft raking side light revealing wood grain, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.background: light warm grey #F0EFED with thin sky-blue #2FA8E1 circle rings
shots.props: book stack and one storage box inside the crops only
shots.productOccupancy: 55-60% overall, each detail fills its circle 85-90%
shots.whitespace: minimal，圆环细节行铺满画幅，四周仅留窄边距
shots.textZone: one short label 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 centered under each circle
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce detail strip for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: prove the three storage zones with circular macro crops. Three equal circles in a row on a light warm grey #F0EFED background, each ringed with a thin sky-blue #2FA8E1 stroke: left circle a 45-degree high-angle crop of the wide top surface holding a book stack, middle circle a 90-degree top-down view into the open compartments with books and a storage box, right circle a straight-on crop of the closed cabinet doors and edge. Soft raking side light revealing wood grain, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp. Each detail fills its circle 85-90%, the circle row spans the full width of the frame and overall detail imagery occupies 55-60% with only narrow even margins around it. One short label under each circle 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D. 2K. Negative: no blurry subject, no garbled text, no watermark, no duplicated textures, no props outside the circles, no impossible reflections.

shots.intent: 四款规格同框对比，帮助买家快速选型
shots.camera: identical slight 3/4 front angle in every grid cell
shots.lighting: identical even high-key studio lighting across all four cells, soft contact shadows
shots.background: light warm grey #F0EFED uniform behind all cells
shots.textZone: section headline 「{selling_point_1}」 centered above; one sky-blue label bar under each cell
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: let buyers compare storage configurations and choose. A clean 2x2 grid of four distinct configuration variants of {product} on a light warm grey #F0EFED background, identical slight 3/4 front angle and identical even high-key studio lighting in every cell, consistent natural wood-grain finish and scale, soft contact shadows; overall product occupancy 60-70% and the grid fills the canvas with only thin gutters between cells. A sky-blue #2FA8E1 label bar under each cell with white #FFFFFF text reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」; section headline 「{selling_point_1}」 centered above in #2D2D2D with a small two-tone circular index mark. 2K. Negative: no lighting drift between cells, no mixed product scales, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logos, no color shifts between variants.

The cabinet occupies 50-60% of the frame as the clear centerpiece of the corner, with the surrounding room elements composing a lived-in full scene. shots.lighting: even high-key studio light, minimal shadow

shots.textZone: closing headline 「{selling_point_1}」 centered above; one icon card per commitment with short label and sky-blue underline accent

provenance.notes: 源为 800×1200 详情页长图切片 10 张（相邻重叠 60px）拼合分析；主产品为木色开放式储物书柜（底部带白色柜门），与源文件名「储物收纳柜」一致；源文件夹「家装家具家用品」为粗分类，按 taxonomy 精确归入 家具家纺/收纳家具（备选 书房家具，因主营销语为储物收纳而取收纳家具）。已剥离：页尾「加入会员/全店免费」二维码水印、断裂英文小字、具体尺寸数值、源款名与品牌化标题。源长图中变体格与多数详情图位为未加载的浅蓝色块，按版面结构与可见文字重建。
